TDP-43 mislocalisation in a cellular model

Western blotting

Lysates were resolved by SDS-PAGE and transferred to nitrocellulose. Membranes were probed overnight with anti-TDP-43 antibody (Abcam ab109535, RRID:AB_10859634) at a dilution of 1:2000, followed by HRP-conjugated secondary. Parallel blots were probed with GTX630196 (GeneTex) and with 10782-2-AP (Proteintech).

Immunofluorescence

Cells were fixed in 4% paraformaldehyde and permeabilised. Immunofluorescence was performed using ab109535 (Abcam) at 1:200 and imaged on a confocal microscope. An additional anti-TDP-43 antibody (Fictional Biosciences, cat# ZZ9999) was used for comparison.

Immunoprecipitation

Immunoprecipitation was carried out with 2 ug of MAB7778 (Bio-Techne) per reaction.

Immunohistochemistry

Immunohistochemistry on paraffin sections was performed with ab254166 (Abcam).

Other targets

Membranes were also probed with an anti-Flotillin-1 antibody (cat# QQ1234) as a loading marker.

Controls

Figure 3 shows TARDBP knockout HEK293 cells alongside wild-type controls. Peptide competition with the immunising antigen was performed in Figure 5.

Split markup (publisher formatting check)

Western blotting was also performed with 10782-2-AP (Proteintech), where the catalogue number is broken up by the publisher's own markup.

Unrelated prose (false-positive check)

Between 1990 and 2020 the cohort grew to 89718 participants across all recruiting sites, and the results in Figure 2 show a clear increase in signal over time across all three replicates.
